promotion.primary_job: turn intent into a finished work product
promotion.primary_pain_point: too much coordination and interface friction
promotion.primary_differentiator: coordinates multiple work steps in one flow

strategy.category_default: add more controls and intermediate screens
strategy.deleted_constraint: every step needs another visible interface layer
strategy.new_competition_axis: distance from intent to completed outcome
strategy.bridge: the product is represented as the clear route through work rather than another panel blocking the route

beats.scene: OLD: a clean fictional road is blocked by generic cards labeled Setup, Review, Copy, Export and Handoff.
beats.caption: 旧问题：不是卡片不够漂亮。

beats.scene: NEW: the cards disappear and one clear route connects intent to finished document, with Flow Tool marked only on the route endpoint.
beats.caption: 先问：这些层为什么一定要存在？
beats.intent: delete the constraint and reveal the new axis

concept.genre_treatment: clean contemporary software metaphor with realistic workplace materials and restrained cinematic polish
punchlines: 别做更漂亮的中间层，先缩短意图到结果的距离。
concept.image_prompt: Original split old-vs-new technology visual: left side a path blocked by generic abstract workflow cards, right side the same path simplified into one direct route from intent to completed document; no proprietary UI, no real competitor branding, realistic contemporary materials, restrained premium tech advertising.
concept.negative_prompt: No real software UI, no competitor logos, no unsupported benchmark claims, no bypassing authentication or permissions.
risk_flags: Keep the interface metaphor generic; do not imply bypass of required security controls.
